verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. All preset constructors, including Blazegraph, now return UpstreamDocs rather than claiming arbitrary caller-supplied endpoints were contacted. The live probe now performs a real SELECT exchange, requires parsed solution results, and only then returns that same concrete configuration through confirmed_live(); focused unit tests also pin constructor provenance and per-configuration promotion. The API cannot technically prevent a caller from invoking confirmed_live() prematurely, but its naming and documentation consistently define it as an explicit post-exchange attestation rather than automatic validation, so this is not a correctness defect in the scoped provenance model.
